_doc: SSH targets for cloud-ide's terminal — it SSHes into the selected phone env's sshd on localhost (Android shares 127.0.0.1 across app sandboxes, so no cross-UID barrier). The Configs 'Terminal backend' switcher (IdePrefs.terminalBackend) picks which env per session. EDIT host/port/user to match your real sshd: termux sshd default is 8022 (the 'phone' ssh alias uses 8023); nix-on-droid sshd port varies. Auth is KEY-based: the hub generates its OWN ssh key on first use — add the public key (Configs → 'Terminal SSH key') to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys in EACH env. No secrets here.
